verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State's own site lists task-oriented guidance pages, such as "Start a Domestic (WA) Business", "How to Obtain an Apostille" and "Close a Corporation Online". That suggests founder-facing how-to explainers exist beyond bare forms, but the pack holds only page titles, so their plain-language, step-by-step depth is unproven. The DOR licensing wizard belongs to a different agency and gets no credit here. Missing for 10: actual explainer content showing step-by-step, non-lawyer language; evidence of coverage across founder tasks; independent or hands-on confirmation of usability.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes plain-language, step-by-step guidance for my task — explainers a non-lawyer can follow, not just statute text and form numbers
